title: SFX, Foley, Procedural One-Shot, Ambience & Soundscape Production

selection_basis.reduced_strict_order: MSAS-01 → MSAS-03 → MSAS-04 → MSAS-05 → MSAS-07 → MSAS-09 → MSAS-12 → MSAS-14 → MSAS-15 → MSAS-18 → MSAS-21
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS-04 remains selected_not_started; MVPS-13 remains selected_not_started.

objective: Implement SFX, Foley, procedural/layered one-shot and ambience/weather/ecology soundscape production over the MSAS session/edit/mix foundations, while preserving AAI soundscape semantics, PCA-08 reusable SFX production primitives, PCA-09 generation orchestration, ARI provenance/rights and provider-off local production.
boundaries: MSAS-01/MSAS-03/MSAS-04/MSAS-05 remain workspace, editing, mixing and music/adaptive foundations consumed by this tranche.
AAI retains cue/soundscape semantics and runtime playback/layering/mixer authority.
PCA-08 retains reusable voice/speech/SFX production primitives and ARI registration; PCA-09 retains generic provider-neutral generation orchestration.
Foley sources and derivatives preserve ARI provenance/rights; generated or procedural outputs remain candidates until explicit acceptance and registration.
Ambience/weather/ecology soundscapes remain layered variable systems; missing resources stay explicit and nonblocking where AAI permits.
Prepared SFX/soundscape state cannot infer, create or mutate canonical gameplay occurrence.
Local/provider-off SFX and ambience production remains blocking-capable; paid/cloud generation is optional.
MSAS-09+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MRCS and MVPS lane state remains independent.
next_action: On an MSAS-specific owner Continue, fresh-read the MSAS-07 dependency closure and msas lane-state ref, then start and execute the bounded tranche under OPS3 v3.9.
